## What you need from this record

The parents. That's the single diagnostic that cracks the cousin question:

Father: probably a Ryan (her surname). Need first name.

Mother: if she's a Gleeson maiden name → Helen is Catherine's NIECE (one of Catherine's sisters married a Ryan in Croom).

Specifically a daughter of one of:

Honora (1866) — age 39 at Helen's birth

Bridget #3 (1868) — age 37

Ellen (1869) — age 36

Mary (1872) — age 33 (and obit confirms Mary stayed in Croom till 1946) ⭐

Margaret (1875) — age 30

Jane (1878) — age 27

If mother is a Hayes → Helen is John Hayes's niece (Catherine's niece by marriage)

If mother is something else → more distant cousin link

## Why this is so important

If Helen's mother is a Gleeson, then:

We have a previously undocumented Gleeson sister marriage in Croom

Possibly resolves the fate of one of our open sisters (Honora, Bridget #3, Ellen, Margaret, or Jane)

Mary Gleeson is particularly interesting since she's documented to have stayed in Croom till 1946

Pull the cert! What does it show for parents?
